column1: # BORU Language Specification: scalar edge cases 4 — temporal values
# Deterministic temporal edges via boru:time-util: every input is a FIXED
# unix epoch (never the clock), so the rows are reproducible anywhere.
# Covers construction + typeof for each Time leaf, chronological
# comparison at the Time LCA (cross-leaf cmp/lt/sort), epoch round-trips,
# fixed-zone conversions with both sides of a DST transition (including
# the skipped and the repeated wall hour), calendar-duration arithmetic
# with Go's month/year normalisation, and the leap-day/century/ISO-week

column3: unix seconds construct an Instant
negative epochs (pre-1970) work
to-date narrows to the Date leaf
to-datetime lifts a Date to midnight
TimeOfDay is its own leaf
sub-second precision survives and renders
negative epochs round-trip
millisecond round-trip is exact

column3: negative calendar durations render component-wise
weeks lower to days, sign preserved
negative clock duration

the zero duration has sign 0

column1: # §3  chronological comparison at the Time LCA — cross-leaf cmp/lt work

column3: Date vs Instant at the same moment: cmp ties (eq is false — see module-time.tsv §19)
DateTime vs Instant ties at the same moment too
Instants order chronologically
a Date orders against an Instant across leaves
tcmp agrees inside the Time band

mixed Date/Instant sort by instant: midnight first
TimeUtil.compare is Date-typed — Instants use core cmp/lt instead

column1: # §4  fixed-zone conversions — offsets, names, and DST on both sides

column3: +09:00 rolls the calendar day forward
Tokyo has no DST — a fixed +09:00
tz-name echoes the IANA id
UTC never observes DST
NY two hours before the 2021 spring-forward: still EST
…at 07:00Z the offset has jumped to EDT
is-dst flips across the same boundary
…to true after 07:00Z
the first post-transition wall time is 03:00 — 02:xx never exists
00:00 EST + 2 ABSOLUTE hours lands at 03:00 EDT — the wall clock skips an hour
fall-back: 05:30Z is the FIRST 01:30 (EDT)…
…and 06:30Z is the SECOND 01:30 (EST) — two instants, one wall time
the repeated wall hour is disambiguated by offset: first pass EDT
…second pass EST
anchoring the NONEXISTENT 02:30 wall time normalises across the gap
anchoring the AMBIGUOUS 01:30 picks the first (EDT) instant
to-local then to-instant round-trips even just past the gap
the UTC round-trip is the identity

column3: the day after Feb 29 is Mar 1
…and after Feb 28 in a common year
stepping back from Mar 1 recovers the leap day
the year boundary
Jan 31 + 1 month NORMALISES: Feb 31 spills to Mar 2 (Go AddDate)
Feb 29 + 1 month is Mar 29 (no spill needed)
Feb 29 + 1 year spills to Mar 1 in the common year
weeks ride the transplanted add as 14 days
a negative duration steps backward across the year
until (later) (earlier) spans forward two months
since (earlier) (later) agrees
the empty span

2100 is NOT (the century rule)

2020 has 366 days

end of the year

column1: # §7  negatives — type discipline at the temporal boundaries

column3: Instant + CalendarDuration is a TYPE error by design (months have no fixed length)
DateTime + CalendarDuration is rejected too — calendar maths needs a Date
